raja_yogas.details: If the lords of dharma sthana (9th) and karma sthana (10th) form a raja yoga, it is known by this special name. The 9th house is the most important trine and the 10th house is the most important quadrant.
One born with this yoga is sincere, devoted and righteous. He is fortunate.
